title: A Treatise on Returning from the Brink
summary: A treatise on keeping a fallen friend from the edge: finding the faint pulse closing deep wounds and calling a breath back in time.

title: The Canon of Many Lives
summary: A canon that spreads rebirth qi round the body as a living field and draws on the echoes of past selves to guard and strike.

title: Treatise of the Twin Lives
summary: A treatise of paired selves and paired hands in which two lives lean on each other and a fallen friend is called back by both.

title: The Hawk and Azure Rebirth
summary: A text of renewal that rises like a hawk and falls on the foe or lowers pale blue qi onto a wounded friend to knit the flesh.

title: The Oath of the Turning Wheel
summary: A text of vows sworn to the turning wheel: a user who swears to rise again strikes harder each time the oath returns.

title: Manual of the Bearing Return
summary: A manual of taking a true bearing on a fallen spirit and following it back to the body before the way closes.
